baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct-like pairing of the sun with its ḍuḥā joins a luminous body to a phase or reach attributed to it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sun supplies the radiating source, while ḍuḥā supplies brightness extended across a rising interval. The focus therefore presents illumination as an unfolding reach rather than a static object.

activation_trace.role: The literal sun and its radiating daylight supply the source from which the focus mechanism extends.
The rising, extended forenoon supplies duration and turns the sun's light into an unfolding interval.
Clear ḍuḥā brightness supplies the qualitative clarity carried through that interval.

changed_reading.before: An oath by the sun followed by an ordinary time of morning.
changed_reading.after: An oath by a luminous source and by the temporal-spatial unfolding of its clear reach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ḍuḥāhā can name not only when the sun shines but the sun's making-visible, heat-bearing exposure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Radiance moves outward until bodies and actions occupy an exposed, public surface. The paired terms thus describe an event of manifestation: a source brings what is outside into visibility.

activation_trace.role: Solar light supplies the physical agent of manifestation.
Exposure to heat, outward prominence, and public visibility supply the manifested field produced by the sun.

changed_reading.before: The verse names a bright celestial object and its time of day.
changed_reading.after: The verse names a source together with its act of placing a field openly under light and heat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal branches of ḍuḥā include both the day's gradual extension and an idiom of slowing or not rushing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The light reaches fullness by measured continuation. This allows the focus to carry a tempo: manifestation ripens through delay rather than arriving as an instantaneous flash.

activation_trace.role: The forenoon's rising extension supplies a process that takes time to reach fullness.
Gentle delay supplies the pacing rule by which the illumination unfolds without haste.

changed_reading.before: Ḍuḥā is a point on a clock.
changed_reading.after: Ḍuḥā is a measured maturation of visibility, with delay functioning as part of how clarity forms.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A focus branch places the ḍuḥā interval around early grazing and a sustaining meal.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sunlight interval organizes embodied access to food rather than merely illuminating scenery. The possessive pairing can therefore be heard as the sun's creature-serving turn or usable allotment.

activation_trace.role: Daylight supplies the environmental condition in which the provision interval operates.
Forenoon feeding and early grazing supply the creaturely use that makes the interval materially consequential.

changed_reading.before: The sun's ḍuḥā is abstract brightness.
changed_reading.after: The sun's ḍuḥā is a usable life interval in which creatures feed, graze, and receive provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Distant branches within the focus root inventory place restive refusal and protective withholding inside the lexical field of the sun, while ḍuḥā places effects in the open.
baseline_models.mechanism: A force that resists capture or guards what lies behind it nevertheless becomes publicly manifest through its ḍuḥā. This yields a tense rather than placid solar image: withheld power declares itself by exposure.

activation_trace.role: Restive refusal supplies a force that will not settle or submit to being ridden.
Guarding and withholding supply the protected interior or reserve carried by that force.
Open prominence supplies the contrary motion by which the guarded or unruly force becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: The sun is a serene emblem of regular brightness.
changed_reading.after: The sun is also a difficult, guarded power whose outward exposure makes its force impossible to keep private.

context_deltas.mechanism: The moon's own light is explicitly placed in following relation to the sun. Followership and a remainder that comes after strengthen the baseline extension model: ḍuḥā is the leading phase of a train, not an isolated span.

activation_trace.role: Extended forenoon supplies the leading duration from which a succession can proceed.
The moon and its sky-light supply the distinct luminous follower.
Following and serial continuation supply the directional link from solar phase to lunar phase.
A remainder following what precedes supplies an afterlight or residual phase rather than mere adjacency.

structural_cues: The paired oath clauses carry the feminine -hā from the sun's ḍuḥā into the moon's act of following.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two luminous bodies, following, and a following remainder. I infer that the second phase can function as an aftereffect of the first. A live alternative is simple calendrical succession with no causal dependence.

changed_reading.before: The sun's ḍuḥā is a self-contained bright interval.
changed_reading.after: The sun's ḍuḥā leads a luminous succession and leaves a phase that can be followed or carried onward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Day is an opening field, and its revealing or polishing action makes the sun manifest. The apparent source of visibility is thus also disclosed by a medium that it helps create, producing reciprocal rather than one-way illumination.

activation_trace.role: The radiating sun supplies the apparent source whose independence is being revised.
Clear brightness supplies the quality that must itself become perceptible in a field.
Day opening through light supplies the receiving field in which the sun appears.
Opening and widening supply the spatial expansion that gives radiance room to become manifest.
Uncovering and appearance supply the day-to-sun direction of disclosure.
Polishing supplies a material analogy in which the medium intensifies the source's legibility.

structural_cues: After the moon follows the sun, the day is grammatically made the actor that reveals the same feminine object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a radiating sun, an opening day, and day-side uncovering or polishing. I infer a feedback relation in which source and medium disclose one another. A live alternative is that the verbs only describe successive views of a fixed sun.

changed_reading.before: The sun independently emits a ready-made ḍuḥā.
changed_reading.after: Solar clarity is relational: it opens the day, while the opened day in turn reveals and sharpens the sun.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exposed field can be overlaid by darkness, while the non-dominant mapped inventory extends covering from surfaces to understanding. The focus's manifestation model therefore becomes reversible physical and cognitive legibility.

activation_trace.role: Open visibility supplies the legible state that can subsequently be covered.
Night and its darkness supply the alternating condition opposed to exposed ḍuḥā.
A covering laid over and concealing a thing supplies the physical reversal of manifestation.
Covering of understanding supplies the exploratory epistemic analogue of the same reversal.

structural_cues: The day-reveals and night-covers clauses form an ordered opposition around repeated -hā.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies open visibility, physical covering, and a secondary mapped branch for obscured understanding. I infer that the visible/covered alternation can model intelligibility as well as light. A live alternative is that the secondary branch is only a form-distant echo with no cognitive force here.

changed_reading.before: Ḍuḥā is a stable condition of visibility.
changed_reading.after: Ḍuḥā is one phase in a reversible contest between disclosure and overlay, with a contained possibility that seeing and understanding rise and fall together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky is both an overhead enclosure and, through a non-dominant mapped root, a surface carrying a visible mark; building joins parts and supports. Solar exposure can thus be read as a legible event inside a constructed field rather than light poured into emptiness.

activation_trace.role: Solar radiance supplies the event placed within the contextual architecture.
Visible prominence supplies the legible appearance produced inside that field.
The overhead sky supplies the enclosing field in which solar disclosure occurs.
A visible identifying mark supplies the secondary mapped image of radiance as inscription or sign.
Joining parts into a construction supplies the assembly relation behind the luminous field.
Ribs and supports supply the material image of a field held in a stable configuration.

structural_cues: The oath sequence moves from observed light cycles to sky plus a maker clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, construction, support, and a secondary visible-mark branch. I infer that the sky conditions and bears the sun's legibility. A live alternative is that construction and marking remain separate images without a shared optical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sun casts its ḍuḥā into undifferentiated space.
changed_reading.after: The sun's ḍuḥā appears as a mark borne and stabilized by a built luminous field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The extension first heard temporally in ḍuḥā is repeated materially as earth spread outward. Fertile ground gives that spread a life-bearing use, so illumination can be read as laying out a habitable surface for action.

activation_trace.role: Temporal extension supplies the focus-side motion that the earth later translates into space.
Early grazing supplies the embodied use that connects sunlight to habitable ground.
Soft fertile earth supplies the life-bearing surface opened under the light.
Spreading and extending supply the horizontal counterpart to ḍuḥā's temporal reach.

structural_cues: Sky/build is followed by earth/spread, changing the oath's geometry from vertical enclosure to horizontal extension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two kinds of extension, a fertile earth, and a grazing interval. I infer that light's temporal spread functionally opens terrestrial room for life. A live alternative is a formal parallel between extensions without an ecological arrow.

changed_reading.before: Ḍuḥā extends through time above the earth.
changed_reading.after: Ḍuḥā also lays out a usable world: temporal illumination becomes the opening of fertile, creature-accessible space.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath turns from exposed cosmos to an inward self with reason and character, formed to completion and made to contain opposed capacities. Breaching a cover and warding harm convert ḍuḥā's visibility into a diagnostic light by which inner directions become distinguishable.

activation_trace.role: Open appearance supplies the focus-side operation transferred from outer surfaces to inward discernment.
Reason and inward awareness supply the interior field that can become legible.
Inner force and character supply dispositions whose directions need disclosure.
Integrity and completion supply the formed container in which opposed capacities can coexist.
Whole ingestion supplies an exploratory image of the paired capacities becoming inward contents rather than external labels.
Deviation and breaching a cover supply the outward-breaking direction exposed within the self.
Warding off harm supplies the opposed protective direction exposed within the same self.

structural_cues: After six cosmic oath objects, the sequence turns to the self and immediately gives it a paired breach/protection structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inward faculty, completed form, internalization, breach, and protection. I infer that solar exposure can act as an analogy for self-disclosure that distinguishes these directions. A live alternative is rhetorical juxtaposition without transfer from physical light to inward diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: The sun's ḍuḥā exposes an external landscape.
changed_reading.after: The sun's ḍuḥā also models an inward disclosure under which a formed self can recognize both its cover-breaking and self-protecting capacities.

context_deltas.mechanism: Spread fertile ground is worked by cutting it, then answers with growth and purification. The forenoon's grazing interval becomes one phase of a cultivation circuit in which exposure enables productive transformation rather than merely revealing what is already there.

activation_trace.role: Sunlight supplies the energy-bearing environmental condition for the cultivation model.
Early grazing and feeding supply the focus-side evidence that illumination enters a nourishment cycle.
Fertile earth supplies the substrate capable of answering exposure with life.
Spreading supplies the preparation of the substrate as an available field.
The cultivator who cleaves earth supplies the intervention that converts an open field into productive ground.
Growth and increase supply the material result of the cultivation circuit.
Purity and soundness supply the ethical result that coexists with material growth.

structural_cues: The success-and-purification clause follows the earth/spreading and self-forming clauses, allowing their material and inward mechanisms to overlap.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile spread ground, a plowing cultivator, growth, purity, and a grazing interval. I infer an enabling arrow from solar exposure through cultivation to increase. A live alternative is that the agricultural chain is only an analogy for inward purification.

changed_reading.before: Ḍuḥā makes an already existing field visible.
changed_reading.after: Ḍuḥā participates in making the field fruitful: exposure, work, nourishment, growth, and purification form a shared transformation circuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fire-making implement that fails to kindle and a movement into hiddenness reverse both solar radiance and ḍuḥā's open prominence. Failure becomes not mere lack of light but the active burial and corruption of a capacity that could have appeared.

activation_trace.role: Radiating daylight supplies the positive condition negated by an implement that will not kindle.
Open visibility supplies the positive direction reversed by concealment.
A fire-striker that fails to produce flame supplies the image of latent brightness that never activates.
Secret insertion or burial supplies the downward, hidden motion opposed to ḍuḥā's emergence.
Corruption supplies the degrading effect of sustained concealment.

structural_cues: The success/purification and failure/concealment clauses are matched opposites, making the second an ablation of the first.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies radiance, failed kindling, open appearance, burial, and corruption. I infer that concealment suppresses a latent capacity rather than merely describing a low state. A live alternative is that fire failure and burial are independent images of disappointment.

changed_reading.before: Ḍuḥā is a neutral fact of outward visibility.
changed_reading.after: Ḍuḥā becomes the positive direction of activated manifestation, while self-burial is its corrupting reversal: an anti-ḍuḥā.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blinding whiteness, an appearance that lies by its condition, and force overflowing its limit weaken any simple equation of brightness with truth. Exposure guarantees publicity, but saturation or deceptive surface can still defeat discernment.

activation_trace.role: Public visibility supplies the baseline condition now separated from truthfulness.
Clear brightness supplies the apparent guarantee that the context complicates.
Vision bewildered by intense whiteness supplies the perceptual failure caused by excessive brightness.
A garment whose appearance misstates its condition supplies deceptive surface despite visibility.
Overflowing water supplies the saturation mechanism by which an otherwise useful force exceeds discernible bounds.

structural_cues: Collective denial appears after the disclosure and purification sequence, testing whether being shown is the same as being acknowledged.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies optical bewilderment, deceptive appearance, and overflow. I infer a glare model in which too much exposure can obscure and public surfaces can lie. A live alternative is that these are unrelated lexical branches and that ḍuḥā remains uncomplicated clarity.

changed_reading.before: What ḍuḥā exposes is thereby clear and truth-bearing.
changed_reading.after: Ḍuḥā makes things public but does not compel true seeing; radiance can become glare, and a fully visible surface can still deceive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's restive force and open prominence are activated by transgression, the stirring of what was still, and a non-dominant image of a rising mountain ridge attached to the worst actor. Emergence into prominence is therefore energetic but not automatically good.

activation_trace.role: Restive refusal supplies an unruly force capable of activation.
Visible prominence supplies the upward or outward arrival of that force.
Boundary-crossing disobedience supplies the direction taken by the activated force.
Stirring something from stillness supplies the transition from latency to action.
The secondary mapped image of a tall rising mountain ridge supplies the strange but visible prominence of the worst actor.

structural_cues: Transgression is followed by the worst member's upward launch, making rising itself structurally suspect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restiveness, exposure, boundary crossing, arousal from rest, and a form-distant rising ridge. I infer a shared activation geometry. A live alternative is that the mountain image is too distant and only the ordinary sense of being sent into action should remain.

changed_reading.before: Solar rising and exposure naturally symbolize beneficial clarity.
changed_reading.after: Rising is morally ambivalent activation: a latent force may enter full prominence as illumination or as destructive transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus already makes ḍuḥā a grazing and feeding interval. A named she-camel and her specific watering share convert that creaturely use into an apportioned commons whose turn must be guarded rather than seized or withheld.

activation_trace.role: Protective guarding and withholding supply the focus-side tension between preserving a share and monopolizing it.
Early grazing supplies the creaturely time-slot that can be treated as an allotted use.
The concrete she-camel supplies the living claimant whose access makes the allocation testable.
A share of watering and its channel supply the explicit resource-allocation mechanism.

structural_cues: Repeated feminine -hā now binds a living creature to her watering allotment, echoing the sun and its ḍuḥā without making their referents identical.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grazing time, a guarded reserve, a she-camel, and an assigned watering share. I infer that the sun's usable interval can model a protected turn within a common resource. A live alternative is a creaturely thematic echo with no allocation structure in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The sun possesses its own ḍuḥā as a natural attribute.
changed_reading.after: Its ḍuḥā can also be heard as a due and usable turn within a life-supporting order, protected from both deprivation and monopolizing restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overflow and impulsive collective motion contrast with messenger-side gentleness and deliberation. These context velocities activate the focus branch of slow ḍuḥā: the difference between ordered manifestation and ruin may lie partly in pace, not only destination.

activation_trace.role: Gentle delay supplies the focus-side norm of unhurried emergence.
Overflowing force supplies acceleration beyond a containing limit.
A group's rushing departure supplies impulsive motion into action.
Gentleness and deliberation supply the counter-velocity aligned with measured ḍuḥā.

structural_cues: Across 91:11-13, overflow, sudden activation, and a messenger's warning form contrasting motion profiles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excess flow, rushing movement, gentleness, and delayed ḍuḥā. I infer a pace axis linking them: regulated unfolding preserves form while haste overruns it. A live alternative is that these branches describe unrelated manners rather than a shared temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Ḍuḥā's delay is merely a lexical curiosity about time.
changed_reading.after: Ḍuḥā's gradual arrival models a disciplined pace of disclosure, sharply opposed to overflow and impulsive mobilization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same forming verb spans completion of the self and equalization after extirpation. Against ḍuḥā's unhidden surface, this repetition activates a double-edged leveling model: exposure may complete a field by making it even and legible, yet total leveling can erase the lives and differences it exposed.

activation_trace.role: Open outward prominence supplies the relatively unshadowed surface on which leveling becomes visible.
Integrity and completion supply leveling's constructive pole in the formed self.
Extirpation supplies the destructive operation adjoining the second leveling.
Equality between things supplies the flattening pole capable of removing differentiation.

structural_cues: The identical sawwāhā form occurs at 91:7 and 91:14 on opposite sides of the narrative, with extirpation beside the latter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constructive completion, destructive extirpation, equality, and open surface. I infer an optical-material analogy between full exposure and leveling. A live alternative is that the repeated verb contrasts divine acts without attributing any leveling force to sunlight.

changed_reading.before: Full ḍuḥā simply improves clarity by removing shadow.
changed_reading.after: Full exposure has a double edge: it can complete and equalize a field for sight, but imagined without limit it can also flatten distinction into erasure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's context opens with a follower and closes with an aftermath. A remainder that follows and an end that leaves a residue turn ḍuḥā's extension into a causal tail: manifestation continues in what comes after it, whether or not that aftermath is feared.

activation_trace.role: Extended forenoon supplies duration capable of projecting beyond the immediate bright moment.
A remainder following what came first supplies the initial image of residual continuation.
Fear as expectation of harm supplies the prospective stance toward what an action may leave behind.
The end and consequence of a thing supply the terminal phase of the causal sequence.
A surviving remainder or trace supplies the residue through which the bright interval continues after itself.

structural_cues: The context begins with what follows the sun and ends with aftermath, bracketing the intervening acts inside succession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal extension, a follower's remainder, expected harm, consequence, and residue. I infer that ḍuḥā can model causal duration whose effects outlive visibility. A live alternative is a purely formal beginning/end frame without an afterlight mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sun's ḍuḥā lasts for a bounded portion of the day.
changed_reading.after: The sun's ḍuḥā models an event with a tail: what becomes manifest enters succession and persists as consequence, trace, or remainder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the sacrificial branch of ḍuḥā is form-distant from the focus's ordinary time sense, yet it remains anchored in the focus root and is reactivated by a protected she-camel being hamstrung. Render only as a ritual resonance that intensifies violation, not as a claim that 91:1 directly denotes sacrifice.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sacrificial-animal branch belongs to the focus root ض ح و, while the focus construction already binds the sun to its own ḍuḥā.

activation_trace.role: The Adha sacrificial animal supplies the focus-root ritual resonance.
The divine name used in oath or call supplies a formal bridge from the opening oath to the protected-animal warning.
The she-camel supplies the concrete animal around which the ritual resonance can activate.
Hamstringing an animal supplies the violent act that converts sacrifice-like imagery into profanation rather than sanctioned rite.

changed_reading.before: The focus is solely a cosmic oath about daytime brightness.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the lexical field, the bright interval carries a sacrificial resonance that makes violence against the protected animal feel like a desecration of an ordered life-giving turn.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates artifact branches from both the focus sun-root and a non-dominant mapping of the watering root. It remains anchored through the focus's own necklace-pendant branch and the explicit following sequence. Render as a compositional metaphor for linked oath-images, never as a lexical replacement of sun or watering.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A branch under ش م س names necklace pendants, allowing the focus pair to function as the first visible unit in a linked series.

activation_trace.role: Necklace pendants supply the focus-root image of a discrete luminous item hung in a series.
Following in sequence supplies the linkage by which one oath-image hangs after another.
The secondary mapped necklace image supplies a distant recurrence of the artifact near the narrative turn.

changed_reading.before: The sun and its ḍuḥā form one item in a list of separate oaths.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus pair is the first pendant in a linked oath-necklace whose successive images gain force through their ordered attachment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the narrow-aperture image comes from a non-dominant split mapping of the sky root. It remains anchored to ḍuḥā's open exposure and is materially supported by building. Render as an optical analogy for channeled disclosure, not as a proposed meaning of samāʾ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus presents the sun's ḍuḥā as outward visibility, which can be materially reimagined as light admitted through a constructed opening.

activation_trace.role: Solar light supplies the beam whose mode of entry is being reimagined.
Outward appearance supplies the visible result produced by admitted light.
A narrow opening through which something enters supplies the form-distant aperture mechanism.
Assembly by joining parts supplies the constructed boundary around the aperture.

changed_reading.before: Ḍuḥā is an unrestricted flood of solar exposure.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory material edge, ḍuḥā is disclosure channeled through an aperture in a built field, with visibility shaped by what admits it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the rare image of a last thing with no successor from the hamstringing root. It remains anchored to the focus's extended interval and the immediate following relation. Render as a contrastive sequence model—cosmic continuity versus violently cut continuation—not as an alternate translation of any single word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sun's extended ḍuḥā opens a sequence that the moon explicitly follows, making continuity part of the focus's activated structure.

activation_trace.role: Extended daylight supplies the recurring interval capable of carrying succession.
Explicit following supplies the normal continuity established immediately after the focus.
A final item after which nothing follows supplies the image of succession cut off.
Extirpation supplies the terminal force that makes the break in continuation total.

changed_reading.before: The sun's ḍuḥā belongs to an indefinitely recurring celestial cycle.
changed_reading.after: The recurring solar interval becomes the standard against which violent social action appears as a severing of succession—an act that leaves no follower.

strongest_changes: Ḍuḥā shifted from a static time label to an extending event whose light opens a field, is revealed by that field, and persists in followers and consequences.
Open brightness became diagnostic rather than automatically truthful: it can disclose inner breach and protection, yet excessive or deceptive visibility can produce glare.
The grazing branch, spread earth, cultivation, growth, she-camel, and watering share turned the focus into a life-supporting and apportioned ecology.
Gradual ḍuḥā supplied a pace model opposed to overflow and impulsive activation, while the worst actor's rising preserved the moral ambivalence of emergence.
Repeated completion/equalization made full exposure double-edged: capable of forming a legible whole or flattening difference into erasure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's apparently simple celestial pair held unusually productive tensions: source and field, extension and remainder, exposure and concealment, provision and withholding, measured ripening and restive force. Context did not resolve these tensions; it activated them into coexisting optical, temporal, ecological, inward, social, and material mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact direction between sun, ḍuḥā, day, and disclosure remains relationally live; the packet permits feedback but does not force a causal loop.
Cognitive covering, visible marking, rising-ridge, aperture, necklace, and watering-necklace activations depend on non-dominant or form-distant branches and should remain explicitly contained.
The cultivation and protected-allotment readings may be causal ecological models or structural analogies for inward and social order; neither needs to displace the other.
The sacrificial resonance is anchored but especially delicate: it should intensify the protected-animal violation only as an exploratory echo, not as a direct gloss of ḍuḥā.
